headline: Bases Exchange Hands as Casualties Surge Across Fronts
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the most volatile sectors have intensified their churn. Weathered Expanse remains the hottest zone, logging forty‑four base transitions in the past day and three in the last two hours, with Colonial losses climbing to 743 per hour and Warden losses to 1,025 per hour, both accelerating. Nevish Line records forty‑two daily flips and two fresh transitions, its casualty rates also accelerating at 579 and 454 per hour respectively. Linn Mercy has surged to sixteen daily flips, though none in the latest two‑hour window; casualties have spiked sharply to 740 and 1,363 per hour. Marban Hollow shows nineteen daily flips and two recent, but casualty trends are cooling. Kuura Strand continues a modest but steady turnover with nine daily flips and six in the last six hours, casualties steady. Stlican Shelf adds five daily flips and two in the last six hours, with losses accelerating to 226 and 441 per hour. Stonecradle sees five daily flips and two fresh, casualties moderate. Farranac Coast and Godcrofts have tapered to quiet, Mooring County holds four daily flips with low losses, while the meat‑grinders at Callahans Passage and Dead Lands bleed heavily without base movement. Enlistment spikes persist across all contested fronts, suggesting the current flare‑ups may sustain through the next day.
